## ⭐ Highlighted — high-priority / trending

### 1. On-Device Content Safety API *(deep pick)*
- **One-sentence description:** A tiered, tunable ML Kit classifier that returns per-category safety scores for user text and images (and screens an app's own GenAI I/O) on ~99% of Android devices, not just the ~3.7% that run Gemini Nano.
- **Type:** A (new capability API) with a Type-F reach core
- **Verdict:** Prototype (developer-preview to collect demand evidence)
- **Opportunity:** 6/10 (Qualified) · **Composite:** 3.65
- **Gates:** Platform Privilege 3/5 pass (weakest) · Feasibility 4/5 pass · Durability 4/5 pass
- **Why high-priority / trending:** carries a dated regulatory forcing function — UK OSA and EU DSA in force now; US age-assurance laws activating Alabama 1 Jan, Utah 6 May, Louisiana 1 Jul 2027; EU DMA Art. 6(7) forcing Alphabet to expose on-device models by 1 Aug 2027. Developer demand is visibly shipped as code (Bumble's `private-detector` 1,366★; `nsfwjs` 9,024★ active).
- **Key risk (kill criterion):** Android's preview `ContentSafetyManager` (API 37.x) could absorb it if it adds tunable per-category scoring first.

## Runners-up (considered and dropped this run)

### 2. On-device eval & quality harness
- **Description:** A build/CI/on-device harness for regression-testing, token accounting, and quality measurement of on-device GenAI features — the thing ML Kit prescribes in prose but ships nothing to execute.
- **Type:** D (tooling) · **Status:** dropped — lost on Platform Privilege (a third party can ship an eval harness as a Gradle dep).
- **Trending signal:** Apple shipped an Evaluations framework + token counting at WWDC26; ML Kit has neither.

### 3. Deferred / opportunistic inference scheduler
- **Description:** A platform primitive to run batched inference "when charging, on wifi, idle" under the shared system model and its quotas.
- **Type:** E (delivery & lifecycle) · **Status:** dropped — strongest gates of the slate, but demand is real-yet-unvocalized and hard to evidence this run.

### 4. On-device neural TTS developer API
- **Description:** A modern on-device text-to-speech API to replace Android's decade-old parametric `TextToSpeech`, filling a gap Picovoice (Orca) sells into and Apple already ships.
- **Type:** A (new capability API) · **Status:** dropped — genuine whitespace but a narrower single-capability bet with no regulatory clock.

### 5. Model-availability state machine / delivery contract
- **Description:** An observable state machine + SLO for on-device model download/availability, so apps stop failing silently and unobservably when a model isn't present offline.
- **Type:** E (delivery & lifecycle) · **Status:** dropped — best-evidenced developer complaint in the ML Kit issue tracker (P8); lost only on reach breadth this run; strong candidate for a future run.
